channel.title: Muhammad Awais — AI Automation Case Studies
channel.description: Documented n8n, Make.com and AI automation case studies by Muhammad Awais, AI Automation Engineer.

item.title: Automated Business KPI Analysis & Growth Insights
item.description: n8n KPI automation that pulls business metrics on a schedule into Google Sheets, flags period-over-period anomalies and writes an AI growth summary.

item.title: Voice AI Appointment Booking with ElevenLabs & Cal.com
item.description: Voice AI booking system: an ElevenLabs agent calls an n8n webhook to check live Cal.com availability and books the appointment before the call ends.

item.title: AI Lead Meeting Scheduling with Zoho CRM, Google Calendar & Gemini
item.description: n8n workflow turning new Zoho CRM leads into conflict-free meetings with timezone detection, Zoom links, Gemini-written invites and CRM logging.

item.title: Dynamic HubSpot Lead Routing with GPT-4 & Airtable
item.description: n8n AI lead routing: a GPT-4 agent scores each new HubSpot contact against an Airtable team database and assigns the right sales rep in seconds.

item.title: Automated LinkedIn Job Search Automation with OpenAI & Telegram Alerts
item.description: n8n LinkedIn job automation that scrapes jobs daily, matches them to a resume with AI, writes tailored cover letters and sends matches to Telegram.

item.title: Instagram Reels Outlier Detection & Telegram Reporting
item.description: n8n Instagram analytics automation that monitors 50+ accounts, scores every Reel against its account median and reports true outliers to Telegram.

item.title: AI Lead Qualification for Real Estate Buyer Inquiries
item.description: AI lead qualification automation that enriches web-form inquiries, scores them 0–100, routes qualified buyers to sales and logs every lead in Airtable.

item.title: End-to-End Client Intake & Onboarding Automation
item.description: Client onboarding automation: four linked workflows for intake forms, booking, reminders, payment and an auto-generated Notion onboarding checklist.

item.title: Automated Slack Reporting Pipeline with Apify and n8n
item.description: Automated Slack reporting pipeline built with Apify, Make.com and n8n that scrapes web sources daily and posts a formatted digest, saving 10+ hrs/week.

item.title: Automated Offer Letter & Response Tracking System
item.description: n8n HR automation that generates offer letters from Google Docs, emails PDFs with Accept/Decline buttons and tracks every response in Google Sheets.

item.title: AI-Powered Review Management System
item.description: AI review management automation that collects Google Maps reviews daily, deduplicates them, drafts a reply to each and routes good and bad feedback.

item.title: Smart WhatsApp AI Assistant with a Google Docs Knowledge Base
item.description: WhatsApp AI assistant that answers customers 24/7 from a live Google Doc knowledge base, with conversation memory kept separately for each contact.

item.title: Advanced Multi-Query RAG System with Supabase & OpenAI
item.description: Multi-query RAG system on Supabase and OpenAI that splits complex questions into sub-queries, filters retrieved chunks by relevance, then answers.

item.title: AI Customer Support Triage System
item.description: AI customer support triage that classifies multi-channel tickets by topic, urgency and sentiment, routes them to Slack and Sheets and auto-replies.

item.title: AI-Powered Email Labeling Agent for Inbox Management
item.description: AI email labeling agent that reads every incoming Gmail message and applies the right label: sponsorship, collaboration, business inquiry or other.

item.title: AI-Powered YouTube Publishing Automation
item.description: YouTube publishing automation that reads pending videos from a sheet, pulls files from Drive, writes SEO metadata with AI and uploads in batches.

item.title: Automated Lead Reply & Follow-Up System
item.description: Lead follow-up automation that updates GoHighLevel for engaged leads and creates ClickUp tasks for silent ones, with idempotent logic so nothing repeats.

item.title: Real Estate Lead Generation & Property Monitoring
item.description: Real estate lead generation automation that tracks property listings against custom criteria and pushes each new match to Telegram, email and the CRM.
